mapper.select: select * from prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.project_meeting_judge_id = #{projectMeetingJudgeId}

SELECT sua.allocation_id AS judge_user_allocation_id, sua.user_id AS judge_user_id, fn.unit_name AS unit_name, fop.position_name AS position_name, fc.company_short_name AS company_short_name, fee.employee_code AS employee_code, fee.name, fe.employee_assign_id AS employee_assign_id, pmj.director_flag AS director_flag, pmj.enabled_flag AS enabled_flag FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge pmj, fnd_employee_assigns fe, sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_org_unit fn, FND_ORG_POSITION fop, fnd_company fc, fnd_employee fee WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id AND fn.unit_id = fe.unit_id AND fop.position_id = fe.position_id AND fc.company_id = fe.company_id AND fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id AND pmj.judge_user_allocation_id = sua.allocation_id AND pmj.company_id = fc.company_id AND fc.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT v1.change_req_id AS changeReqId, v1.judgeCount, v2.approvedCount, v3.rejectedCount, v4.savedCount, concat( ROUND ( ( v2.approvedCount / v1.judgeCount ) * 100, 0 ), '%' ) approved, concat( ROUND ( ( v3.rejectedCount / v1.judgeCount ) * 100, 0 ), '%' ) rejected FROM ( SELECT ppmj.change_req_id, count(1) judgeCount FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.absence_flag != 'Y' AND ppmj.change_req_id = #{changeReqId} AND ppmj.project_meeting_id = ( SELECT max(ppmj.project_meeting_id) FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.change_req_id = #{changeReqId} ) GROUP BY ppmj.project_meeting_id, ppmj.change_req_id ORDER BY ppmj.project_meeting_id DESC ) v1, ( SELECT count(1) approvedCount FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.Judge_approve_result = 'APPROVED' AND ppmj.project_meeting_id = ( SELECT max(ppmj.project_meeting_id) FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.change_req_id = #{changeReqId} ) AND ppmj.absence_flag != 'Y' ) v2, ( SELECT count(1) rejectedCount FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.judge_approve_result = 'REJECTED' AND ppmj.project_meeting_id = ( SELECT max(ppmj.project_meeting_id) FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.change_req_id = #{changeReqId} ) AND ppmj.absence_flag != 'Y' ) v3, ( SELECT count(1) savedCount FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.Judge_approve_result = 'SAVE' AND ppmj.project_meeting_id = ( SELECT max(ppmj.project_meeting_id) FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.change_req_id = #{changeReqId} ) AND ppmj.absence_flag != 'Y' ) v4 WHERE v1.change_req_id = #{changeReqId}

SELECT ppmj.project_meeting_judge_id, ( SELECT su.USER_NAME FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = ppmj.judge_user_id ) user_name, ( SELECT su.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = ppmj.judge_user_id ) userDescription, CASE ppmj.Judge_approve_result WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '同意' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '拒绝' ELSE '保留' END Judge_approve_result, ppmj.approved_time, ppmj.Judge_approve_comments FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj WHERE ppmj.project_meeting_id = ( SELECT max(ppmj1.project_meeting_id) FROM prj_project_meeting_Judge ppmj1 WHERE ppmj1.change_req_id = #{changeReqId}
) and IFNULL(ppmj.absence_flag,'N') != 'Y'

SELECT v1.project_meeting_Judge_id, v.*, v1.director_flag, v1.absence_flag, v1.anonymous_flag AS anonymousFlag FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ppmj.project_meeting_Judge_id, ppmj.judge_user_allocation_id, ppmj.director_flag, ppmj.absence_flag, ppmeet.anonymous_flag FROM prj_project_change_meeting_judge ppmj LEFT JOIN prj_project_meeting ppmeet ON ppmeet.change_req_id = ppmj.change_req_id WHERE ppmj.project_meeting_id = ( SELECT max(ppmj1.project_meeting_id) FROM prj_project_meeting_Judge ppmj1 WHERE ppmj1.change_req_id = #{changeReqId}
) ) v1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fe.employee_assign_id, sua.allocation_id as judge_user_allocation_id, ( SELECT max(sua.user_id) FROM sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id /*LIMIT 1*/ ) judge_user_id, ( SELECT unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fn WHERE fn.unit_id = fe.unit_id ) AS unit_name, ( SELECT position_name FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.position_id = fe.position_id ) AS position_name, ( SELECT company_short_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = fe.company_id ) AS company_short_name, ( SELECT employee_code FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id ) AS employee_code, ( SELECT NAME FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id ) AS NAME FROM fnd_employee_assigns fe, sys_user_allocation sua where fe.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id ) v ON v1.judge_user_allocation_id = v.judge_user_allocation_id
mapper.update:
